title: Agent edits and retractions (mimi-content replaces): applied on receive from the original sender, sent from Message/set; unknown originals dropped; history kept; first-version IDs in the plaintext store
description:
Bead mimid-kmhd. Sources: mimi-content-10 §3.3 (replaces), §5.5 Edit, §5.6 Delete, §9.1 (unknown replaces is legitimate), §9.3 (only the original sender may edit or delete; only the NestedPart may change); draft-atwood-jmap-chat-mimi-00 §Message Identifiers, §Edits, §MLS Messages, §Security Considerations; draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00 §Message (editedAt, editHistory, deletedAt, deletedForAll), §MessageRevision, §Editing a Message, §Deleting a Message; room-policy-04 §8.3.

1. Receive, edit. A received message whose `replaces` resolves (§Message Identifiers: senderMsgId or alias, same Chat) and whose body is not a NullPart updates that Message: `body` and `bodyType` from the edit as for a new message, `editedAt` the hub's acceptance time of the edit (so every receiver agrees; jmap-chat-00 only says "time of the most recent edit"), and the old body/bodyType pushed onto `editHistory` as a MessageRevision with that `editedAt`. The agent retains edit history (`retains_edit_history` true; jmap-chat-00 "MAY limit"): at most MAX_EDIT_HISTORY = 32 revisions, the oldest dropped. INVENTED, NOT FROM SPEC: the limit. The edit's inReplyTo, topicId and expires are ignored (content-10 §9.3: the original sender may change only the NestedPart). An edit's attachments (ExternalParts) are not applied: jmap-chat-00 sets `attachments` only at creation, so the Message keeps its own and the edit's are reported in SyncReport.problems. An edit with neither text, attachments nor NullPart is listed in `skipped`.
   Competing reading: re-fetch the edit's attachments and replace the Message's. Rejected: JMAP Chat attachments are creation-only, and a caption edit usually re-sends the same parts.

2. Receive, retraction. `replaces` with a NullPart body (content-10 §5.6) sets `deletedAt` (the hub's acceptance time of the retraction), `deletedForAll` true, `body` "", `attachments` [], and removes `editHistory` (jmap-chat-00 §Message deletedAt). The tombstone stays (no hard delete). Pending attachment retries and the kept report record (frank and plaintext) of that Message are dropped, since deletion removes the content; a retracted message therefore cannot be reported. An Unlike is the same thing applied to whatever Message the reaction was stored as.

3. Aliases. Octets 1..10 of each applied edit's and retraction's own message ID are recorded as an alias (§Edits says "each edit"; a delete is a replacement in content-10 §5.6, and recording it makes a redelivered retraction a no-op). A reply or reaction naming any version resolves to the Message. At most MAX_ALIASES = 256 per Message (INVENTED, NOT FROM SPEC); past it an edit is refused and reported in problems (fail closed). A message whose own reference already resolves is not stored or applied again (the existing duplicate rule, §Security).

4. Sender. An edit or retraction is applied only if its authenticated MLS sender's user URI equals the original Message's sender (the owner's URI for senderId = accountId, else the ChatContact identity). content-10 §9.3 MUST NOT unless "a specific, concrete authorization policy"; jmap-chat-mimi §Security SHOULD. A refused one changes nothing, records no alias, and is reported in SyncReport.problems. room-policy-04 §8.3 canDeleteOtherMessage (moderator retraction) is not honored: the agent does not evaluate message capabilities on receive at all today (canSendMessage, canEditOwnMessage, canDeleteOwnMessage are not checked either). Limitation.

5. Unknown original: dropped, listed in SyncReport.skipped, not held. content-10 §9.1: "could have been sent before the local client joined". The hub orders a room's messages, so the original cannot arrive after its edit; one not stored here (before the join, skipped as unstorable, or destroyed by the client) never will, and holding would keep state forever. An edit of a Message already retracted is likewise dropped and listed in skipped.

6. Send. `Message/set` update of `body` (and `bodyType`, text/plain only by the account's limits) on the owner's Message in a room-bound Chat sends a MIMI edit through the agent (Agent::send_edit -> send_content): `replaces` the first version's full message ID, text/plain SinglePart, no inReplyTo/topicId (own Messages are created without them). `deletedForAll: true` sends a retraction (Agent::send_retraction: NullPart). The edit's/retraction's own ID becomes an alias, and the owner's edit pushes a MessageRevision like a received one. A local delete (`deletedAt` without `deletedForAll`) is local and sends nothing (jmap-chat-00). crate-jmap's handler already checks senderId = accountId and deletedAt absent, and routes the patch to `ChatBackend::update_object`, so no crate-jmap change is needed. mentions/broadcastMentions/reactions stay forbidden.
   `replaces` is a 32-octet MessageId, but a Message keeps only 10 octets (senderMsgId). The first version's full MIMI message ID and the aliases are kept per Message in the plaintext store beside it (like the report records), not as a Message property: Mark rejected mimid-only JMAP properties. INVENTED, NOT FROM SPEC: that store record. A Message stored before this record existed has none, and editing it is forbidden.

7. draft-atwood-jmap-chat-mimi-00 §MLS Messages says "The server MUST reject a Message/set update that changes body, bodyType, or reactions of a Message in a Chat with a roomId". Readings: (a) it binds any JMAP Chat server whose Chats carry roomId, which includes the agent's local endpoint, so edits must be refused; (b) it binds the provider role of §MLS Messages, whose roomId Chats hold application/mimi-fanout ciphertext Messages that it cannot re-encrypt; a converting party that holds plaintext maps the update to a MIMI edit (§Edits, and jmap-chat-00 §Editing a Message). Chosen: (b). The section is about the provider; the agent is the converting party, and (a) would make §Edits unusable for any gateway that shows roomId. The draft should scope the sentence: bead filed (label wg).
